violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §744.1203(2))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For
violation_type.typical_finding: It was found during the inspection caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.

finding_variants.text: It was found during the inspection caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.

A caregiver responsible for a group of 29 children between the ages of 4yrs. and 11yrs. old did not know the number of children currently present. The caregiver stated there were 32 children currently present.
It was found during the inspection caregivers stated they had 26 children and they had 32.
Staff member did not know the how many children were in care. Staff member counted and stated that there were about 40 children present.  Inspector reviewed sign in log and 33 children were present.
One caregiver was unaware of how many children they were responsible for.
A caregiver stated he had 23 children, I then asked how many children he had in his class at the time and he stated 15 when I counted they were 16 children in care.

One class stated they had 12 children and 16 were present.  One classroom stated they had 14 children and 17 were present.  One classroom stated they had 18 children and 19 were present. occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: Three caregivers in each of the 3 classrooms did not know how many children they had in care. The caregiver in charge of the younger group 5-7 stated there were 20 children, but he was not sure how many children he had because some had left. The caregiver then counted the children while I was present. The caregiver in charge of the group ages 8-10 counted the children while I was present and the caregiver in charge of the group ages 5-11 had to look at the sign in log to count the children.
